summary_en: The study tests mirdametinib, a MEK inhibitor, in people with Langerhans cell histiocytosis, juvenile xanthogranuloma, Rosai-Dorfman disease, or other histiocytic disorders. Mirdametinib is taken by mouth twice daily on a continuous schedule, with each cycle lasting 4 weeks; the total length of treatment is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa mirdametinib, un inhibidor de MEK, en personas con histiocitosis de células de Langerhans, xantogranuloma juvenil, enfermedad de Rosai-Dorfman u otros trastornos histiocíticos. El mirdametinib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día, de forma continua, con ciclos de 4 semanas; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. El resultado principal no se indica; este es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Age 2 years or older with a histiocytic disorder that needs systemic therapy.
Diagnosis confirmed by biopsy review or molecular testing, or by a positive blood test in cases where biopsy is not feasible.
Measurable disease on PET scan or brain MRI.
Adequate kidney, liver, blood count and albumin levels; abnormalities caused by the disease are allowed.
not_for: Cytotoxic myelosuppressive chemotherapy within 14 days, or a MEK inhibitor within 30 days or 5 half-lives, or disease progression on a MEK inhibitor.
